doc.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

title: Reflecting on the boat; Ralf Kemper funds Developing Story
summary: He says he is grateful every day he got on the boat, and that producer Ralf Kemper financed 'Developing Story' and the Dave Brubeck album.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Yeah. Okay. I’m wondering if you have moments of, I’d guess I’d call reflection. I was watching you in Abbey Road Studios with this forest of fantastic musicians and you’re conducting. Do you ever have a moment afterwards where you go, “God I’m glad I got on that boat.”

Oh yeah. Every day. Every day. Yeah. So yeah I still have to scratch myself for a few things like that, that’s how Ralf Kemper, the producer, took it upon himself to finance the whole “Developing Story” and the Dave Brubeck album. Amazing fellow.
Ralf, as in German, R-A-L-F Kemper. So you know, very — he loved the music, what can I say? So — I wish it sold a million copies.
